body: Arts and Culture Commission Special Meeting
minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS & CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Special Meeting

  Thursday, May 16, 2019 at 3:30 p.m.
1. ROLL CALL
   The meeting was called to order on May 16, 2019 at 3:32 p.m.
   Present: Commissioners Oshagan, Tufenkian, Vice Chair Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
   The Agenda for the May 16th Special meeting was posted on the bulletin board outside City
  Hall on May 15th 2019.

2. BUSINESS AGENDA
  A. Discussion Item(s)
  1. Placement for First Iconic Art Piece.

    Director Shaffer stated there was no staff report for this meeting, instead the
  discussion will center on the possible placement of an iconic art piece within the City of
  Glendale. He pointed out that today there will be no decisions and only discussion of
  the various places an art piece can possibly be installed.

    Chair Vidor suggested median strips on Glenoaks and on Brand and possibly connect
  them in some way for placement of iconic art piece. She also stated she liked the idea
  of starting an art piece by the median strip or by the Seely’s area and moving north.

    Commissioner Oshagan stated it was hard to separate the art piece and the placement
  because it’s very much a site specific process and that the nature of the location
  impacts the artwork.

    Commissioner Tufenkian stated that a gateway location in north Brand by the freeway
  or South Brand border by Atwater and the Seely Building would be some places for the
  iconic art piece.

    Commissioner Tufenkian stated that median would not be a good place for an iconic
  piece, it would need to be something that would define Glendale as an art city. She
  suggested a main entry way or a meeting place like the Central Library.

    Commissioner Zadorian stated that iconic piece should be on a less foot trafficked
  area but enough where it draws attention. She suggested locations like Brand and
  Glenoaks, across from Trader Joes and the parking lot by Glendale College.

3. ADJOURNMENT – 4:02 p.m.

The next regular meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission is July 18th, 2019, at 2:00 p.m. in the City
Council Chambers, 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
